content.value_statement: Terraform work often spans setup, modules, state, environments, pipelines, and security controls. This skill organizes those steps into a clear infrastructure workflow.
actual_capabilities: Guides Terraform project setup with providers, variables, outputs, and backend planning.
Breaks cloud resource provisioning into design, networking, compute, and storage steps.
Supports reusable module planning with interfaces, structure, documentation, and testing checkpoints.
Covers remote state, state locking, workspaces, access controls, and backup planning.
Outlines multi-environment deployment, CI/CD integration, security, and quality gates.
limitations: Does not include provider-specific source code or ready-to-run Terraform files.
Requires existing Terraform knowledge, cloud account access, and environment details.
Does not validate live infrastructure or apply Terraform changes by itself.
Relies on related skills for deeper provider and pipeline implementation patterns.

use_cases.title: Plan New Cloud Infrastructure
use_cases.description: Map the Terraform setup, providers, resources, state, and outputs before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Standardize Reusable Modules
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable module workflow that includes inputs, outputs, documentation, and test checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Improve Terraform Delivery
use_cases.description: Organize multi-environment configuration, CI/CD plan steps, approvals, security controls, and release gates.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Terraform Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to plan a Terraform project for [cloud], [environment], and [services]. Include providers, backend, variables, outputs, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reusable Module
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to design a Terraform module for [resource type]. Define its interface, structure, documentation, test plan, and release checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up State and Environments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to plan remote state, locking, workspace or folder strategy, environment isolation, access controls, and backup practices.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Terraform Delivery Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to review Terraform delivery for [system]. Assess CI/CD, approvals, security controls, compliance checks, and rollback readiness.

output_examples.input: A team needs Terraform guidance for a new staging environment.
output: Project setup checklist with providers, backend, variables, and outputs.
Resource planning sequence for networking, compute, storage, and dependencies.
Quality gates for validation, state readiness, and security review.

output_examples.input: A platform team wants a reusable module process.
output: Module interface plan with required inputs, outputs, and versioning notes.
Documentation and testing checkpoints before publishing the module.
Review steps for compatibility across environments.

output_examples.input: A DevOps lead wants safer Terraform CI/CD.
output: Pipeline stages for formatting, validation, plan review, approval, and apply.
State, secret, and access control checks before production changes.
Release readiness checklist for audit and rollback planning.

best_practices: Review every Terraform plan before any apply operation.
Keep remote state encrypted, locked, backed up, and access controlled.
Use modules, variables, and environment separation to reduce drift and duplication.
anti_patterns: Do not paste cloud credentials, state secrets, or private keys into prompts.
Do not apply infrastructure changes without plan review and approval.
Do not mix production and non-production state without clear isolation.

faq.question: Does this skill run Terraform commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides a workflow for planning and reviewing Terraform work.

faq.question: Can it create Terraform modules?
faq.answer: It guides module design, structure, documentation, and testing steps. It does not ship ready-made modules.

faq.question: Which cloud providers does it support?
faq.answer: The workflow is provider-neutral. Users must supply provider details and constraints.

faq.question: Does it cover Terraform state?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes backend setup, locking, workspaces, access controls, and backup planning.

faq.question: Is it useful for CI/CD?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines plan, apply, validation, approval, and security gates for Terraform pipelines.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
